title: Recover reusable delete journals on store open
description: Wire reusable-update journal recovery into flat-file store initialization and task/catalog loads under the global lock. A prepared journal must restore every before snapshot; a committed journal must finish every after snapshot. Recovery must be idempotent, validate the entire journal and all target content before replacement, retain the journal when recovery fails, and remove it only after successful convergence. Define safe interaction and ordering with the existing batch-update recovery path so the two journals cannot silently overwrite each other. Add focused internal and fault-injection tests for interruption at each recovery replacement, repeated opens, missing target files, status-directory moves, catalog-only and multi-task recovery, and retained diagnostics. Do not expose delete through the provider yet.
